discord.heading: Discord
discord.subtitle: Connect DS2000 to your Discord account
discord.intro: Discord only lets an application control your microphone if you created that application yourself. It is free and only has to be done once.
discord.statusFailed: Could not read the Discord status.
discord.missingFields: Enter both the Client ID and the Client Secret.
discord.saved: Saved. Authorise the application in the Discord window.
discord.redirectHint: Redirect to add under OAuth2 → Redirects:
discord.step2Body: The secret is kept in Windows Credential Manager, never in the settings file.

step3Body.unset: Discord asks for permission once, the first time you connect.
step3Body.waiting: If Discord is closed, open it: DS2000 reconnects on its own.
step3Body.awaiting: Open Discord and accept the DS2000 request.
step3Body.connected: The DS2000 keys now control your voice in Discord.
step3Body.closed: Open Discord: DS2000 connects on its own as soon as it is running.

discord.unlinkText: The Client ID, the secret and the authorisation are deleted. To connect again you will have to paste the credentials again.
